run_base_sweep: run base_sweep to generate a sweep of BBBConfig objects over learning_rate and adaptive_scale hyperparameters
run_prior_sweep: run prior_sweep to generate a sweep of BBBConfig objects over sigma_1, sigma_2, and mixture_scale prior hyperparameters
run_network_sweep: run network_sweep to generate a sweep of BBBConfig objects over hidden_sizes network architecture hyperparameters
run_batch_sweep: run batch_sweep to generate a sweep of BBBConfig objects over batch_strategy and num_batches training hyperparameters
run_combined_sweep: run combined_sweep to generate a combined sweep of all BBBConfig hyperparameter configurations
